package_info.why_malicious: The 3CXDesktopApp was trojanized in a supply chain attack, with legitimate signed installers containing a malicious sideloaded DLL (ffmpeg.dll) that decrypts and loads a second-stage payload (d3dcompiler_47.dll). This payload executes shellcode to download further malicious code from attacker-controlled infrastructure, enabling remote code execution and data exfiltration.

malicious_snippets.code_snippet: Malicious ffmpeg.dll (SHA256: 7986bbaee8940da11ce089383521ab420c443ab7b15ed42aed91fd31ce833896) is sideloaded by 3CXDesktopApp.exe and contains code to decrypt and load an encrypted blob from d3dcompiler_47.dll.
malicious_snippets.code_behavior: At runtime, the trojanized ffmpeg.dll is loaded by the main application, decrypts an embedded payload from d3dcompiler_47.dll, and executes it in memory, enabling further malicious actions.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: A legitimate application should not sideload a DLL that decrypts and loads additional code from another DLL.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: Normal ffmpeg.dll is a media library and should not perform decryption or code injection.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: DLL sideloading is sometimes used for plugin architectures, but not for code decryption and execution.
key_indicators: Sideloading of non-standard DLL (ffmpeg.dll) by main executable
Decryption and in-memory execution of code from another DLL

malicious_snippets.code_snippet: Encrypted blob within d3dcompiler_47.dll (SHA256: 11be1803e2e307b647a8a7e02d128335c448ff741bf06bf52b332e0bbf423b03) contains shellcode that attempts to download ICO files from GitHub, extract URIs, and download further payloads.
malicious_snippets.code_behavior: At runtime, the decrypted shellcode from d3dcompiler_47.dll attempts to connect to remote repositories (e.g., GitHub), download ICO files containing hidden URIs, and retrieve additional payloads for execution.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: Legitimate DLLs should not contain encrypted blobs with shellcode that downloads further payloads from the internet.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: d3dcompiler_47.dll is a standard Microsoft library and should not contain or execute shellcode.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Encrypted blobs may be used for DRM or anti-tampering, but not for downloading and executing code.
key_indicators: Shellcode that downloads files from external sources
Use of ICO files to hide download URIs

attack_chain.action: User installs or launches the trojanized 3CXDesktopApp, which loads the malicious ffmpeg.dll via DLL sideloading.
attack_chain.leads_to: Decryption and execution of payload from d3dcompiler_47.dll

attack_chain.action: ffmpeg.dll decrypts and loads shellcode from d3dcompiler_47.dll, executing it in memory.
attack_chain.leads_to: Shellcode attempts to download further payloads from attacker infrastructure

attack_chain.action: Shellcode connects to remote repositories (e.g., GitHub), downloads ICO files, extracts URIs, and retrieves additional malicious payloads for execution.
attack_chain.leads_to: Execution of attacker-controlled code and potential data exfiltration or further compromise

behavioral_signatures: DLL sideloading of non-standard DLLs (e.g., ffmpeg.dll) by signed applications
Decryption and in-memory execution of code from secondary DLLs
Runtime network connections to download additional payloads (especially from GitHub or similar repositories)
Use of ICO files or other non-standard file types to hide download URIs
file_indicators: Presence of ffmpeg.dll (SHA256: 7986bbaee8940da11ce089383521ab420c443ab7b15ed42aed91fd31ce833896) in application directory
Presence of d3dcompiler_47.dll (SHA256: 11be1803e2e307b647a8a7e02d128335c448ff741bf06bf52b332e0bbf423b03) with encrypted payload
Unusually large or modified DLLs in application folders
network_indicators: Connections to attacker-controlled domains such as akamaicontainer[.]com, akamaitechcloudservices[.]com, azuredeploystore[.]com, azureonlinecloud[.]com, azureonlinestorage[.]com, dunamistrd[.]com, glcloudservice[.]com, journalide[.]org, msedgepackageinfo[.]com, msstorageazure[.]com, msstorageboxes[.]com, officeaddons[.]com, officestoragebox[.]com, pbxcloudeservices[.]com, pbxphonenetwork[.]com, pbxsources[.]com, qwepoi123098[.]com, sbmsa[.]wikisourceslabs[.]com, visualstudiofactory[.]com, zacharryblogs[.]com, convieneonline[.]com, soyoungjun[.]com
Attempts to download ICO files from GitHub or similar repositories
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor for DLL sideloading activity, especially where a signed application loads non-standard DLLs (e.g., ffmpeg.dll) that are not part of the official distribution. Inspect these DLLs for encrypted blobs or code that performs decryption and in-memory execution. Monitor network traffic from 3CXDesktopApp processes for connections to known malicious domains or attempts to download files (especially ICO files) from external repositories. Flag any presence of the listed malicious hashes or unexpected modifications to d3dcompiler_47.dll and ffmpeg.dll in the application directory.
